note: Image loading, conversions, recipe and library storage, recorded in S06 on Qt 6.12.0. No budget covers these metrics (U4 is in perf_ui_baseline). Numbers compare only on this machine. Each metric is the last of 3 runs of the same build (one session, back to back); medianRangeOf3Runs and p95RangeOf3Runs show the spread over all 3 runs. The OS file cache was warm: the load times are decode times, not disk times. RCP-SAVE-5000 had a median of 483 ms in the third run (93-99 ms in the other two); three more runs of the recipe test alone gave 87, 99 and 167 ms. The cause is not known (disk or virus scan are guesses).
method: perf_storage: 5 MP loads 3 warm-up and 15 measured runs, 25 MP loads 1 and 5, copying conversions 3 and 15, recipes 5 and 30, background save 25 runs with the first 5 dropped, library save and open 3 and 15, library find 5 and 30, zero-copy wrappers 30 samples of 1000 calls each. Median and p95. Copies are the countImageCopy delta of one load.

machine.measurementHygiene: process priority HIGH; power throttling off; thread pinned to logical CPU 0 (efficiency class 1 of 2 classes)
